author: ansonkk1
quote: 13 years and $2 billion later, and somehow it still doesn't live up to the hype. There's somehow less to do than GTA 5, and I'm not sure why they would introduce censorship into a GTA game of all things. On top of that, the game feels like an unfinished product, riddled with bugs and lacking the polish you'd expect from a game with this much time and money behind it. Pretty disappointing considering how long we've waited.

author: ansonkk1
quote: Improved upon an already existing masterpiece. I had a great time playing through the entire game. Although they made it noticeably easier than the original, it was still an amazing experience from start to finish.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
